tests.name: every checkpoint was reached and its court and its surrounding ground both traced

detail.note: an instrument that cannot read one side cannot compare the two, and a half-read site would otherwise fall through the flatness gate as a pass

tests.name: there is collidable floor on every checkpoint's court plate
the court sits where the build said the ground was

detail.note: the paving modules are 6 cm proud of their placement z, so a correct court reads a few centimetres high; tens of centimetres means the pass was authored against the wrong floor

tests.name: the court is flush with the ground beside it -- no lip a player trips on

detail.note: compared against the REAL floor outside the bay, not against the number the build assumed

tests.name: the march is still walkable through every checkpoint

detail.note: swept 60 m of carriageway per nation with the Dog's own capsule; the bays are supposed to widen the road, not narrow it

tests.name: every checkpoint that was given a landmark actually has one standing

detail.note: read downward from 120 m. A tower whose socket stack raised or whose site was refused leaves no error behind, only a checkpoint with no silhouette

tests.name: every checkpoint is still readable at midnight

detail.note: the same two gates the night proof uses, read on the court patch rather than the whole frame, because the requirement is that the CHECKPOINT reads after dark
